name: loopboard
description: MCP server for the loopboard Claude plugin: gather Slack and Jira conversations into Miro, then export board items to Jira

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
